evidence.observation: Pressure gauge and exhaust oxygen sensor are not installed; pressure and purge effectiveness cannot be verified.
Growth readings are T 750.3 C against 750 C setpoint, Ar 100.0 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint, heater power 46.0%, and status running; measured temperature and flow track setpoints.
Growth-entry temperature reached 760.8 C, then settled to 750.0 C by 2760 s; no persistent temperature deviation is evident.

args.missing_evidence: Independent tube-pressure and exhaust-oxygen measurements are needed to verify the growth atmosphere and gas-path conditions; sample characterization is needed to assess target growth.
